So the gradient is the same as without clipping, and the probability of the mistaken action is lowered at full strength. This is exactly how the PPO authors describe their objective: “we only ignore the change in probability ratio when it would make the objective improve, and we include it when it makes the objective worse.” Clipping limits only the favorable steps.

Политику руля Ады можно учить таблицей ц: Can Ada's steering policy be learned with a table of action values, as on the apartment grid from lesson 5.1?
Да, если сделать таблицу подробнее: Yes, if you make the table finer
Нет: руль и наблюдения непрерывны, состо: No: the steering and the observations are continuous, no state repeats, and choosing the steering would require searching for a maximum over all values at every step; so the policy itself is trained
Да, градиент политики и есть такая табли: Yes, the policy gradient is exactly such a table
Стохастическая политика выдаёт распредел: A stochastic policy outputs a distribution over steering, a mean and a spread, and its weights are moved by the policy gradient. Sutton and Barto suggest doing this for continuous actions in Section 13.7.
REINFORCE подталкивает только действия,: Does REINFORCE push up only the actions followed by a positive return?
Да, остальные он не трогает: Yes, it leaves the others alone
Нет: каждое действие подталкивается с ве: No: every action is pushed with the weight of its return; if the returns are almost always positive, almost all actions go up, and the signal drowns in noise
Нет, он подталкивает только самое удачно: No, it pushes up only the best action of the episode
В поездке Ады из интерактива отдача поло: In Ada's drive from the interactive, the return is positive at 49 of 68 steps, although the drive ended in a crash. The baseline V(s) turns the return into an advantage that takes both signs.
Базовая линия b(s) смещает оценку градие: Does the baseline b(s) bias the gradient estimate, so it has to be kept small?
Да, чем больше b, тем сильнее смещение: Yes, the larger b is, the stronger the bias
Нет: если b зависит только от состояния,: No: if b depends only on the state, the average direction of the gradient doesn't change, while the variance can drop noticeably; the natural choice is the value V(s)
Базовая линия нужна только для дискретны: A baseline is only needed for discrete actions
Вычтенная часть, усреднённая по действия: The subtracted part, averaged over the policy's actions, gives zero (Sutton and Barto, Section 13.4). Bias appears elsewhere: when the advantage estimate trusts an inaccurate critic, as GAE does with λ = 0.
Чем больше эпох по одной порции опыта, т: Do more epochs on one rollout batch mean more use from the collected data, with no clipping needed?
Да, данные надо использовать по максимум: Yes, the data should be used to the fullest
Нет: без ограничения несколько эпох по о: No: without a limit, several epochs on one rollout take the policy too far; in Ada's corridor, without clipping 0% of drives reach the kitchen by the end of training
Нет, больше одной эпохи нельзя никогда: No, more than one epoch is never allowed
PPO и придуман, чтобы проходить по порци: PPO was designed precisely to run several epochs over a rollout without destructive updates. In the PPO paper, the variant with no clipping or penalty scored −0.39, worse than a random policy.
Обрезка в PPO не даёт отношению вероятно: Does clipping in PPO keep the probability ratio r from leaving [1 − ε, 1 + ε]?
Да, r жёстко зажато в этом отрезке: Yes, r is strictly clamped to this interval
Нет: обрезка гасит градиент отдельного п: No: clipping zeroes out the gradient of an individual example, but the shared weights move for the sake of others, and this example's r can go further
Да, но только при положительном преимуще: Yes, but only with a positive advantage
В лаборатории 2 после пяти эпох с ε = 0,: In Lab 2, after five epochs with ε = 0.2, 20% of the steering decisions ended up outside [0.8, 1.2], and 72% without clipping. Rudin et al. also adapted the step size by KL.
Действие хуже обычного, но его вероятнос: An action is worse than usual, but after a few minibatches its probability has grown 1.6 times. Will clipping prevent fixing this?
Да: r за пределами отрезка, градиент рав: Yes: r is outside the interval, and the gradient is zero
Нет: минимум выбирает необрезанный член,: No: the minimum picks the unclipped term, which is worse, and the gradient pulls the probability down at full strength
Да, если ε меньше 0,6: Yes, if ε is less than 0.6
Целевая функция PPO — пессимистичная оце: The PPO objective is a pessimistic bound: a change in r is ignored when it would make the objective better and taken into account when it makes the objective worse. Only the favorable steps are limited.
Если без обрезки политика разваливается,: If the policy falls apart without clipping, is it enough to just reduce the step size?
Да, и это ничем не хуже PPO: Yes, and it is no worse than PPO
Политика перестанет разваливаться, но бу: The policy will stop falling apart but will learn slowly: in Ada's corridor, a step size 10 times smaller gives 48% of drives to the kitchen versus 99% for PPO
Нет, с маленьким шагом политика развалив: No, with a small step size the policy falls apart even faster
У малого шага медиана KL за обновление о: With the small step size, the median KL per update is about 0.0025, and for PPO about 0.0095. The TRPO authors wrote that the penalty the theory calls for makes the steps very small, and replaced it with a constraint.
При той же порции опыта больше параллель: With the same rollout batch, are more parallel robots in the simulator always better?
Да, больше роботов — больше разнообразия: Yes, more robots means more variety
Нет: каждый робот получает меньше шагов: No: each robot gets fewer consecutive steps, and GAE needs the rewards of several steps; in Rudin et al., the algorithm struggled with fewer than 25 steps
Нет, число роботов ни на что не влияет: No, the number of robots doesn't matter at all
Лучшим компромиссом для своей задачи авт: The authors name 2048–4096 robots and rollout batches of about 100,000–200,000 steps as the best compromise for their task. Their final setup is 4096 robots with 24 steps each.
